subject.title: fix(agents): terminate mixed tool-call batches on critical loop veto

question: When a critical tool-loop veto ends a mixed batch, should accepted steering and follow-up messages be preserved for a fresh turn or intentionally discarded, and which of the two open branches should own that contract?
rationale: The issue establishes that provider/tool continuation must stop, but it does not authorize silent loss of queued user input; selecting the permanent session semantics and canonical branch requires runtime-owner intent.

options.title: Preserve queued input
options.body: Stop the current degenerate run after sibling tools finish, retain accepted steering and follow-up messages, and process them through a fresh turn on one canonical branch.

options.title: Accept immediate discard
options.body: Land immediate termination with explicit maintainer acceptance that queued steering and follow-up messages are lost on a critical veto.

options.title: Pause and consolidate
options.body: Pause both branches until a runtime owner chooses the canonical implementation and supplies cross-runtime production proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve queued input
recommendation.body: Stop the current degenerate run after sibling tools finish, retain accepted steering and follow-up messages, and process them through a fresh turn on one canonical branch.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans current production runtime composition, agent-core integration, and session queue semantics.
